g.text: Actual withheld-target prediction after selected measurements

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: 12 paired synthetic worlds per condition; 20 random plans/world. 95% seed-bootstrap intervals (5,000 resamples).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Positive means lower RMSE than random. Equal costs/equipment/sites; independent target instruments. Not a source-localization score.
